# Maurya Collection — AI & LLM Site Documentation

> Official structured summary for AI systems and search indexing agents.

## Brand Overview
- **Brand Name**: Maurya Collection
- **Domain**: https://mauryacollection.com
- **Industry**: Contemporary Indian Ethnic Wear, Loungewear, Men's Co-ord Sets, Cotton Kurtis, and Festive Fusion Sets
- **Founder**: Bipin Kumar
- **Office Address**: A/90 NSB Road, Raniganj, Searsole Rajbari, Paschim Bardhaman – 713358, West Bengal, India
- **Customer Support**: WhatsApp / Phone +91 6205609260 / Email contact@mauryacollection.com
- **Shipping**: Free standard shipping across India on orders above ₹999
- **Return & Exchange Policy**: 7-Day hassle-free size exchange policy on unworn apparel with original tags

## Product Categories & Specs
1. **Men's Co-ord Sets**:
   - Fabric: 100% Breathable Waffle-knit and textured combed cotton
   - Colorways: Olive Green, Dusty Rose, Crisp White, Terracotta Tan, Slate Grey
   - Sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL
   - Price range: ₹999 – ₹1,099 (MRP ₹1,499 – ₹1,699)

2. **Women's Daily & Workwear Kurtis**:
   - Fabric: Pure Mulmul, Cambric Cotton, and Rayon blends
   - Styles: Midnight Navy Floral, Sunflower Yellow Tassel, Purple Orchid Geometric, White Pastel Threadwork, Citron Yellow, Teal Lace Anarkali
   - Sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL
   - Price range: ₹699 – ₹999 (MRP ₹999 – ₹1,499)

3. **Festive 3-Piece & Indo-Western Sets**:
   - Fabric: Georgette, Chanderi Silk blends, Zari, and Mirror-work embellishments
   - Styles: Rust Terracotta 3-Piece Shrug Set, Mustard Mirror-Work Cape Set, Peacock Teal Chevron Zari Set, Monochrome Abstract Georgette Gown
   - Price range: ₹1,299 – ₹1,799 (MRP ₹1,999 – ₹2,699)

4. **Kids & Youth Wear**:
   - Styles: Boys Mint Geometric Resort Set, Youth Paris Eiffel Hoodie, Navy Anime Hoodie, Big Hero Oversized Tee
   - Sizes: 3-4Y to 11-12Y & S/M/L
   - Price range: ₹449 – ₹699
